# Sun Robotics & AI

> Sun Robotics & AI is an Indore, India-based robotics company building
> humanoid and industrial robots, alongside an enterprise IT Services
> practice.

Sun Robotics & AI designs and builds industrial robotic arms and is
developing a humanoid robotics platform, engineered for manufacturing,
logistics, and quality-control use cases. Its SunBot Vision AI product uses
computer vision for automated visual inspection. Alongside its robotics work,
the company runs an IT Solutions practice offering custom website
development, app development, enterprise APIs, and cloud/IoT integration for
businesses in Indore and across India.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://sunroboticsandai.in/): Overview of the humanoid and industrial robotics platform, plus IT Services.
- [About](https://sunroboticsandai.in/about): Company mission, values, and team.
- [Contact](https://sunroboticsandai.in/contact): Address, phone, email, and contact form.
- [Careers](https://sunroboticsandai.in/careers): Open positions.

## Robotics & AI

- [Robotics](https://sunroboticsandai.in/robotics): Industrial robotic arms and multipurpose robotics platforms engineered for manufacturing, logistics, and quality control.
- [Products](https://sunroboticsandai.in/products): SunBot Vision AI, an AI-powered visual inspection system for quality control.

## Sun IT Services

- [Sun IT Services](https://sunroboticsandai.in/sunitservices): Indore's leading IT services and custom software company. Specializes in custom website development (React, Next.js), mobile app development (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter), enterprise backend APIs, cloud hosting (AWS), and IoT system integration.
